[1] Just use your E) Black Shield on your allies and watch him come near you just to get Binded.
[2] She'll spell-shield your target every time and it's generally hard to dodge her Q because your hit-box is MASSIVE.
[2] Morgana is the worst matchup you can get. Her Q roots you for a long time, her E mitigates your engages and she deals tons of damage.
[2] She can use her E to deny your hook, but if she doesn't use it right away and instead uses it to block your ult you can break the shield with your magic damage to then get your ult off anyways.
[2] Ideally you want to bait her Black Shield and go in as soon as it goes down. Another option is to hook her and change focus on the target that is not protected by her E.
[2] Don't try it, she can blackshield most of your engage and if you end up in her q it's free damage on you. My advice: go gank mid.
[2] If she spell-shields late, you can still break it with E and lock someone with your passive.
[2] Instead of trying to catch her or adc, hook a nearby wall and root them with your AA.
[2] Morgana's 3rd (Black Shield) can cancel your Dread Line ( First Skill) and Depth Charge (Last Skill)
[2] Focusing her to force her Spell Shield on herself can open up her team mates.
[2] Dodge q's and turn on whoever didn't get the spell shield.
